meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读写 ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json,帮你查看、添加或移除 agent 容器可访问的主机目录,并标出每个目录是只读还是读写,也能把列表重置为空。
howto.when: 当你提到 “mounts”、“mount allowlist” 等关键词,或要求改动 agent 容器可访问的目录时触发。改动会在新建容器时自动生效。

say.text: 看看当前的 mount allowlist 里有哪些目录
say.note: 列出允许的目录及其读写权限

say.text: 把 /home/me/data 加进允许目录,只读就行
把 /home/me/old 从允许列表里删掉
say.note: 移除该条目并重写配置

howto.what_en: Claude reads and writes ~/.config/nanoclaw/mount-allowlist.json to view, add, or remove host directories NanoClaw agent containers can access, noting whether each is read-only or read-write, and can reset the list to empty.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "mounts", "mount allowlist", etc., or ask to change which directories agent containers can access. Changes apply when a container is spawned.

say_en.text: Show which directories are in the current mount allowlist
say_en.note: Lists allowed dirs and their access mode
Validates the path, then writes config
Drops that entry and rewrites config
